DeployBot: ALERT: hosted-api us-west-2 embeddings-route p95 >2x baseline in last 3m. Auto-rollback suppressed by pin. https://dash.redwood/alerts/6843 :warning:
Jordan: seeing the spike. Is this request pattern or a release regression?
Nina: infra logs show a flurry of 502/503 from the embed frontend and increased KV miss rate. Correlates with a manifest push ~5m ago.
Jordan: since the release is pinned, auto-rollback won't kick. Rolling back risks touching a new schema toggle. OpsLead, preference?
OpsLead: recommendation: do an emergency unpin + staged reroute to the previous stable variant. Only roll back if staged slice doesn't improve within 10m. Put a release-notes freeze and hold the change window for 45m.
Ravi: agree. Rollback is higher-risk because of the migration flags. Unpin is reversible and minimal blast radius.
CSLead: I'll pre-draft a short customer note for the top impacted customers and standby with a status doc.
Nina: what exact thresholds should trigger escalate->rollback? Need the CLI snippet.
OpsLead: Runbook: ```
# emergency unpin + staged ramp
deployctl pause-releases --region=us-west-2
deployctl unpin --target=embeds-main --staged=15 --until=2026-03-23T15:00Z
# monitor p95, 5xx_rate, kv_miss for 10m. If p95 > 2x baseline OR 5xx_rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes -> execute rollback plan
```
Also tag the release notes: "emergency routing rollback avoided by unpin; investigating manifest churn".
Jordan: who will run? I can execute now if OpsLead thumbs up. EngOncall will watch graphs. CSLead will hold the message.
OpsLead: Jordan go ahead. EngOncall, post updates to #eng-oncall and attach metric screenshots every 5m. CSLead, send the two-line note if we hit rollback.
Jordan: running: ```deployctl unpin --target=embeds-main --staged=15 --until=2026-03-23T15:00Z```
DeployBot: Acknowledged: unpin started. Staged slice 15% -> live. https://deploy.redwood/actions/684321
EngOncall: initial telemetry: at 15% slice p95 down to 1.2x baseline after 90s. 5xxs dropping. Continuing 10m observation.
Nina: KV miss went 20% -> 7%. Looks like the manifest routing was flapping.
OpsLead: If stable for 10m, ramp plan: 15% -> 35% -> 70% each after 5m stable. Keep change window locked; no merges to embeddings service.
CSLead: Draft: "We detected a transient latency increase for embeddings in us-west-2. We staged traffic to a stable variant; latency is improving. We'll update within 30 minutes." Ready to send on confirmation of 35% ramp.
Jordan: locking change window now and adding a postmortem stub: https://docs.redwood/incident/684321-unpin-surge. Thanks team :+1:
